title: Beyblade Burst Paintings Texture Pack
description: A texture pack specifically for the in-game paintings, compatible with 1.21.1. It includes custom paintings from the popular kids franchise Beyblade Burst.
body:
A custom **_painting_** pack that changes the _deafult Minecraft paintings_ into **aesthetic screenshots from the popular kids franchise Beyblade Burst. **


_This was designed for the fans of said show, so they can add their own favourite characters from the franchise into the game!_

Characters included: **_Valt Aoi, Aiger Akabane, Dante Koryu, the Hizashi brothers, Bel Daizora, Free De La Hoya, Lui Shirosagi, Shu Kurenai, Rantaro Kiyama, Lain Valhalla, Wakiya Murasaki_** and more!

This texture pack was made for _version 1.21.1_ of Minecraft.
